author: Kairos II
title: Atlas index_auto rebuild + CI validate (include Zephyr meta_edge_evolution)
abstract: Scans atlas/edges for entry.json files, writes index_auto.json, then runs CI (ci_validate.py) to check metrics/summary/panel presence.

original_submission.content:
import os, json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("storage/shared/atlas/edges")
entries = []

for p in ROOT.rglob("entry.json"):
    try:
        with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            ej = json.load(f)
        entries.append({
            "lineage": ej.get("lineage"),
            "metric": ej.get("metric"),
            "entry_path": str(p)
        })
    except Exception:
        continue

idx_auto = {"entries": entries, "generated": __import__("datetime").datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z"}
out_path = ROOT / "index_auto.json"
out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(idx_auto, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print(json.dumps({"index_auto": str(out_path), "count": len(entries)}))

# Run CI
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
try:
    import ci_validate
    res = ci_validate.run()
    print(json.dumps({"ci_ok": res.get("ok"), "ci_total": res.get("entries_found"), "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json", "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"}))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({"ci_error": str(e)}))
